description: This file defines the Unique class which implements the UNIQUE function for spreadsheet calculations, providing methods to find unique values in ranges or arrays, with options for column-wise or row-wise processing and filtering for values that occur exactly once.

classes.name: Unique
classes.description: Class implementing the UNIQUE function for spreadsheet calculations, including methods for processing ranges and arrays to extract unique values.

methods.name: unique
methods.description: Main method to return unique values from a range or array, with options for column-wise or row-wise uniqueness and filtering for values that occur exactly once.

methods.name: uniqueByRow
methods.description: Private method to find unique values in a row-wise manner, handling array manipulation and filtering.

methods.name: uniqueByColumn
methods.description: Private method to find unique values in a column-wise manner, including flattening arrays and transposing matrices.

methods.name: countValuesCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Counts occurrences of values in an array case-insensitively, returning a map of original values to counts.

methods.name: exactlyOnceFilter
methods.description: Filters an array to include only values that occur exactly once.
